ორიენტირისთვის, ცალკეული დამატებითი მომსახურებები შეიძლება ღირდეს: ღუმელის გაწმენდა — დაახლოებით 20–40 ₾; მაცივრის შიგნიდან გაწმენდა — დაახლოებით 25–50 ₾; ერთი ფანჯრის რეცხვა — დაახლოებით 20–30 ₾; შინაური ცხოველის ბეწვის სპეციალური მოცილება — დაახლოებით 30–50 ₾.
As of July 2026, deep cleaning an apartment in Georgia usually costs about GEL 120–350.
Cleaning a large apartment or private house may cost GEL 300–600 or more.
A common starting rate is around GEL 2.5–3.5 per m², although many providers also have a minimum booking price.
In Batumi, deep cleaning for a small apartment often starts at around GEL 120–150.

Property type Approximate size Estimated price Studio or small apartment 25–40 m² GEL 120–180 One-bedroom apartment 40–60 m² GEL 140–220 Two-bedroom apartment 60–90 m² GEL 180–320 Large apartment 90–120 m² GEL 250–420 Private house 100–150 m² GEL 300–600+ These figures are only estimates.

Typical additional charges may include: oven cleaning — about GEL 20–40; cleaning inside a refrigerator — about GEL 25–50; cleaning one window — about GEL 20–30; specialist pet-hair removal — about GEL 30–50.
A small upholstery-cleaning job may start at around GEL 30, while a large sofa or heavily stained surface costs more.
Post-renovation cleaning in Georgia may start at around GEL 3–7 per m², although complicated properties can cost considerably more.
Conclusion Deep cleaning a house or apartment in Georgia generally costs GEL 120–350.
For a large apartment or private house, the price may reach GEL 300–600 or more.
